description: Export the committed model through one export target into an absolute output directory, as File > Export as does: moc3, cmo3, vtube-studio, psd-pose, p2lrt, web, unity, png-sequence, sprite-sheet, gif, mp4, webm, mov, apng, webp. settings are the target's own keys (listed on the settings field); unset keys take the target's default or the project's export settings. Writes the files and <name>.<target>.report.json; returns a job handle whose result lists the files and what the target could not carry (losses).

request_id.description: Unique request ID. Retry unchanged arguments with this ID to recover the same result; use a new ID for a new attempt.

state.description: Opaque state from workspace_inspect or the preceding result. Includes load generation and durable version; history node IDs are not state tokens.

settings.description: Values are strings. Keys per target: moc3: physics=true|false (true), user_data=true|false (true), display_info=true|false (true), hidden_parts=true|false (true), hidden_meshes=true|false (true), guide_parts=true|false (false), pixels_per_unit=1..100000 (auto); cmo3: timestamp=<epoch milliseconds>, clips=true|false (true); vtube-studio: physics=true|false (true), user_data=true|false (true), display_info=true|false (true), hidden_parts=true|false (true), hidden_meshes=true|false (true), guide_parts=true|false (false), pixels_per_unit=1..100000 (auto); psd-pose: clip=<clip id or name>, time=0..3600 (0), pose=<ParamAngleX=20,ParamEyeLOpen=0>, scale=0.25..2 (1); p2lrt: v1=true|false (false), compress=true|false (false), zstd=true|false (false), strip_names=true|false (false), pose_groups=<PartArmA|PartArmB; PartHatA|PartHatB>, advanced=true|false (true); unity: clips=true|false (true), clip_fps=1..120 (30), pixels_per_unit=1..100000 (100), sample_pairs=0..1000 (48); png-sequence: clip=<clip id or name> (first clip), fps=1..120 (auto), size=16..8192 (1024), physics=true|false (true), background=<AARRGGBB>; sprite-sheet: clip=<clip id or name> (first clip), fps=1..120 (auto), size=16..8192 (1024), physics=true|false (true), background=<AARRGGBB>; gif: clip=<clip id or name> (first clip), fps=1..120 (auto), size=16..8192 (1024), physics=true|false (true), background=<AARRGGBB>, dither=true|false (true); mp4: clip=<clip id or name> (first clip), fps=1..120 (auto), size=16..8192 (1024), physics=true|false (true), background=<AARRGGBB>, ffmpeg=<path to ffmpeg>; webm: clip=<clip id or name> (first clip), fps=1..120 (auto), size=16..8192 (1024), physics=true|false (true), background=<AARRGGBB>, ffmpeg=<path to ffmpeg>; mov: clip=<clip id or name> (first clip), fps=1..120 (auto), size=16..8192 (1024), physics=true|false (true), background=<AARRGGBB>, ffmpeg=<path to ffmpeg>; apng: clip=<clip id or name> (first clip), fps=1..120 (auto), size=16..8192 (1024), physics=true|false (true), background=<AARRGGBB>, ffmpeg=<path to ffmpeg>; webp: clip=<clip id or name> (first clip), fps=1..120 (auto), size=16..8192 (1024), physics=true|false (true), background=<AARRGGBB>, ffmpeg=<path to ffmpeg>

project_id.description: Current project_id from workspace_inspect; null only when no project is loaded.
